about_the_game:
Unsent is a wacky 3D platformer set in a labyrinthine 1970’s inspired post office.  

Freshly out of work, Valentine has turned to his latest employment opportunity: a postman at the Unsentiment Department. Jump, dash, and fight your way through your postal route as you deliver letters that were never meant to be Unsent.

Welcome to the Regulatory Realm 

Explore the Regulatory Realm, a world where superstitions manifest as bureaucracies. This reality manifests wherever wonder still remains; nooks in trees, the underside of couch cushions, and in the cracks above your childhood bed. 

The Unsentiment Department

The Unsentiment Department is one such bureaucracy that stores all Unsent letters. The Unsentiment Department is extremely disorganized and sometimes letters fall through the cracks. General Postmaster, the domineering and stubborn head of the Unsentiment Department, almost seems to enjoy the inefficiency of the system.

Send the Unsent

Throughout your journey as a postman, it's your job to deliver letters that have slipped from the human realm into the Unsentiment Department. Valentine's mail route will bring him from dilapidated mansions to bleak suburban neighborhoods in his quest to provide closure to those who never received their letters.

Gameplay Features

  • A gorgeous world full of goofy and loveable characters

  • An engaging story about a whimsical bureaucracy and the little guy forced to navigate it

  • 4 levels packed full of charming characters and challenging platforming puzzles

  • REALLY good jokes

  • Hundreds of collectibles

  • An undead pigeon

  • A zany yet wonderful soundtrack
